title: ttheme market
description:
The ttheme-market.toml at the root of a ttheme market: a repository or folder whose palettes/*.toml and palettes/<catalog>/*.toml are the market's palettes
https://github.com/kecan0406/ttheme/blob/main/docs/usage.md#markets

palette.description: A palette's bare name, its file name under palettes/ without .toml

$schema.description: This file's JSON Schema, for editor completion and checks; ttheme ignores it

name.description:
The market's name: its palettes are <owner>@<name>/<palette>, where the owner is the repository's owner on GitHub
https://github.com/kecan0406/ttheme/blob/main/docs/usage.md#markets

description.description: What the market holds, shown in ttheme browse, ttheme market and the market page

name.description: The owner's GitHub handle, which names a market read from a folder; a market added from GitHub takes its repository's owner instead

email.description: An address for questions about the market

url.description: The owner's page, such as a GitHub profile

renames.description:
Palettes that were renamed or removed: an old name maps to its new name, or to false once it is gone. Installs of the old name follow the chain on the next update, so keep the entries after everyone has moved
https://github.com/kecan0406/ttheme/blob/main/docs/usage.md#markets

force_remove_deleted_palettes.description: Whether a palette that leaves the market without a rename is removed from the machines that installed it; by default they keep their copy

metadata.description: Anything else the owner wants to keep here; ttheme does not read it
